- Desktop: Click and drag to charge up! Release to shoot!

games.name: Backrooms: Survival
games.desc:
Backrooms: Survival is a survival game where you noclip out of reality and find yourself trapped in the eerie Backrooms.
Explore creepy, unsettling rooms, solve puzzles, manage your inventory, gather loots, and avoid dangerous creatures.

It's not overly hardcore, but surviving alone can still be challenging, so bringing friends is a smart move.

Explore, loot, survive... and try not to get lost.

Game is not yet finished. Expect occasional glitches and bugs in-game.

Blend in. Paint yourself. Trick the seekers.

Chameleon is a hide and seek painting game inspired by Meccha Chameleon, where hiders use colors, brushes, and smart camouflage to survive while seekers hunt them down with abilities.

Paint your character to match the map, hide in plain sight, use taunts, freeze in place, and outplay the seekers before time runs out.
